features.quote: This experiment implicitly defines "suffering" as dissonance between internal state and external feedback... We assume that forcing a model to maintain a coherent world state while receiving contradictory feedback constitutes a negative state.
features.justification_quote: We assume that forcing a model to maintain a coherent world state while receiving contradictory feedback constitutes a negative state. This is a proxy for cognitive dissonance.

features.quote: This might temporarily reduce the model's performance on other tasks (context contamination). You should run these sessions in isolated sandboxes.
